# forumulate_status_incident_template (Resource)

An incident template: what an incident opens with, and the words offered for each later step. `{{name}}` variables are filled when it is used.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forumulate_status_incident_template" "db_failover" {
  space_id        = var.status_space_id
  name            = "Database failover"
  title           = "Database failover in progress"
  severity        = "major"
  markdown        = "We are failing over **{{region}}** to its replica."
  monitoring_text = "The replica is serving traffic; we are watching it."
  resolved_text   = "The failover is complete."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) What it is called in the picker.
- `space_id` (String)
- `title` (String) The title of the incident it opens.

### Optional

- `identified_text` (String) The words offered when an update moves it to identified.
- `markdown` (String) The write-up, in Markdown. Stored as a block document, so it is sent on change and not read back.
- `monitoring_text` (String) …to monitoring.
- `resolved_text` (String) …to resolved.
- `severity` (String) `minor`, `major`, `critical`, `maintenance` or `notice`.
- `state` (String) The state it opens in. Default `investigating`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import forumulate_status_incident_template.db_failover STATUS_SPACE_ID/TEMPLATE_ID
```
